decisions.reason: The account branding and audience-routing instructions do not change which source videos or material may be selected for clips.
Creating and branding the Instagram account does not change the metrics, coverage, or transparency of posted-clip performance tracking.
The phrase "Best moments from Arden Vale" is proposed profile bio copy, not a change to the substantive moment-selection standard for clips.
The account setup instructions contain no change to clip hooks or the applicable hook guidelines.
Requiring account creation before clipping does not alter the assigned clip count, batch deliverable, or deferred lifecycle of the trial batch.
The Instagram profile and audience-routing requirements do not modify the requirement that each clip contain a complete standalone narrative.
Account branding instructions do not change the visual editing style or prohibited visual treatments for clips.
The source decision does not mention or alter the required 70–85 second clip duration.
The account setup prerequisite does not change the monthly approved-clip target, approval basis, or treatment of rejected clips.
The profile image, bio, and account-link instructions do not affect caption colors or text effects within clips.
The Instagram account setup decision contains no instruction changing the required caption font.
